pending_carry_forward.reason: No local Keycloak service in docker-compose.yml; E2E against a real IdP needs a test realm or a keycloak service — accepted, dev-bypass covers local dev, adding the service is out of AUTH-01's scope

OAuth `state` is generated per /auth/login but never verified on /auth/callback — the bearer-only, cookie-less topology has no server-side store. CSRF vector on the authorization-code flow. Deferred per D-12; PKCE is the intended fix (Keycloak-supported, needs no server-side session). MUST be resolved before the pilot rollout in REQUIREMENTS.md § Rollout plan — not a merge blocker, but not open-ended either.

`_peek_kid` (unverified JWT-header parsing, ~10 lines) is duplicated between app/auth/oidc.py and app/core/auth.py; core/auth.py's copy is private. Violates reusability-baseline (DRY across modules of the same concern). Extract to a shared helper (e.g. app/auth/jwt_utils.py). No behavioural impact.

`_RefreshRequest` is defined in app/auth/oidc.py rather than app/schemas/auth.py alongside TokenResponse and DevBypassRequest. Inconsistent with the codebase's schema-location convention. No behavioural impact.

app/auth/oidc.py::_log_dashboard_login's jwt.decode/.validate still passes no claims_options, unlike the fixed get_current_user. MEDIUM: it resolves user_id for a log line only — not an authz decision, and it fails to the 'unknown' sentinel rather than to access. Unify via a shared helper (also resolves AF-09's _peek_kid duplication).

No rate limiting on /auth/callback, /auth/refresh, /auth/dev-bypass, against .claude/rules/security-baseline.md's auth-endpoint throttling invariant. Raised both gate rounds. Needs an explicit fix or a recorded accepted-risk decision before pilot.

No test covers iss/aud being ENTIRELY ABSENT (only wrong-value). The code is correct — _claims_options uses essential:True and authlib raises MissingClaimError, verified against 0.15.6 source — but that path has no regression guard. Extend conftest's build_access_token with omit-iss/omit-aud options.

docs/requirements/auth.md § session's transport field does not name the new iss/aud enforcement. Shipped behaviour is a strict superset of the documented contract, not a drift; a future doc pass should state it explicitly.
